tasks.short: Arrange lawful disposition of seized fish or game and maintain custody records.

steps.what: Retrieve case restrictions, disposition procedures and authorised recipient details
Examine fish or game identity, condition and custody status
Determine the permitted disposition route and any unresolved legal restrictions
Write disposition instructions and the planned custody transfer record
Check and arrange disposition with the authorised external recipient
Check identity and custody details at the arranged fish or game handover
Record the completed disposition, recipient and custody evidence

tasks.design: Configure procedure views and disposition record templates in {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DOCS}. The warden determines the lawful route, separately writes instructions, arranges the external handover and records completion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedure navigation and repeated custody fields add handling around a consequential disposition.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case views and reusable record fields may reduce repeated entry.
tasks.still_hard: Legal restrictions, physical condition and lawful custody transfer.
tasks.human_edge: The warden verifies what is actually being transferred and to whom.
tasks.altitude: Reduce custody record handling without automating disposition decisions.

reach.learn: Keep planned and completed transfers distinct

evidence.claim: Native case views and templates can reduce repeated disposition fields; this benefit is unmeasured and does not establish legal authority.

assumptions: Includes instructions, recipient coordination, the warden's handover checks and completion record; no other role's physical disposal labour is claimed as saved.

Warden produces case ID, species/item identity, quantity, condition, restriction, recipient and planned route in s2-s4 and actual date and custody evidence in s7, with capture counted. Missing authority or uncertain identity requires manual resolution.
Use native case views and templates first; no model, automated recipient choice or implied machine send.
Ordinary record saves remain retained without self-approval.
unknowns: Applicable disposition procedures and case system fields
research_questions: Which custody fields are repeatedly entered rather than reused from the case?

already_counted.description: Capture planned and completed disposition records

incremental.description: Maintain procedure views and custody field defaults

approvals.approved_version: Exact items, legal route, recipient and planned transfer instructions; changed restrictions or recipient require another check before arrangement.
Actual items and recipient at handover against the final arrangement and current restrictions; any mismatch stops transfer.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=92.25, gross=7.75, upkeep=2, central net=5.75 E1. Low: unusual restrictions and uncertain item identity require bespoke custody records, retaining 98 hours plus upkeep for zero net. High: standard recipient and case metadata permit partial field reuse while restrictions and actual handover remain fully checked, retaining 95 hours plus upkeep for 3 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Promote and deliver hunter or trapper safety training with separate enrolment and completion records.

steps.what: Retrieve current hunter or trapper safety requirements and training materials
Prepare safety training materials and practical exercise plans
Write the safety training invitation and participation details
Check and send the training invitation to hunters or trappers
Record enrolments and participant requirements before training
Check current instructions and provide practical hunter or trapper safety training
Assess safe practice and determine further instruction needs
Record attendance, completion and further safety training needs after instruction

tasks.design: Use current-material views and training templates in {DOCS}, with native enrolment and completion fields in {LMS}. Invitation writing and sending through {EMAIL} are separate, followed by direct instruction, human assessment and a later completion record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated material preparation and training administration surround direct teaching.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable course and record templates may reduce clerical preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Safe practical behaviour and adapting instruction to participants.
tasks.human_edge: The instructor observes and corrects unsafe practice immediately.
tasks.altitude: Reduce preparation and administration around practical safety teaching.

evidence.claim: Native course templates and training record fields can reduce repeated preparation; no measured warden training benefit is available.

assumptions: Includes promotion, pre-session enrolment, instruction, assessment and post-session completion records in time order.

Warden produces session date, venue, requirements and contact details in s2-s5, and attendance and observed outcome in s7-s8, with capture counted. Missing participant details require manual clarification; completion is never inferred from enrolment.
Native templates and fields first; no automated safety assessment or completion decision.
Ordinary record saves remain fully included in retained entry time without self-gates.
unknowns: Existing training templates and record system
research_questions: How much material preparation can reuse current validated content?

incremental.description: Maintain training templates and record fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact invitation, safety requirements, date, venue and recipients; edits require another send check.
Current instruction package and exercises for this participant group and equipment; changed procedures require checking before teaching.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=91, gross=9, upkeep=2, central net=7 E1. Low: unfamiliar participant needs and changed safety procedures require new materials, retaining 98 hours plus upkeep for zero net. High: current course materials fit the group while practical exercise adaptation remains manual, retaining 94 hours plus upkeep for 4 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and deliver accurate wildlife conservation and regulation information to community audiences.

steps.what: Clarify the school, civic group, sporting club or media information needs
Retrieve current wildlife conservation evidence and applicable regulations
Write the presentation, speaking notes and audience handout
Check conservation claims, regulation currency and audience suitability
Check final materials and address the audience, including questions
Record the outreach activity and unresolved audience questions

tasks.design: Configure current-information folders and reusable presentation and handout templates in {DOCS}. The warden writes and checks the material, delivers the address, then separately records activity and unresolved questions in {OPS_SYSTEM}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source retrieval and presentation formatting add preparation time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native folders and presentation templates can reuse current public information.
tasks.still_hard: Audience engagement, unexpected questions and explaining regulations accurately.
tasks.human_edge: The warden adapts explanations and earns audience trust.
tasks.altitude: Make preparation lighter while preserving direct community engagement.

reach.learn: Adapt checked information to different audiences

evidence.claim: Native presentation templates and source folders may reduce repeated preparation; this is an unmeasured E1 scenario.

assumptions: Includes preparation, writing, factual checking, the address and its existing activity record; no follow-up send is assumed or counted as saved.
Warden produces audience, scope and source versions in s1-s3 and activity date and unresolved questions in s6, with capture priced. Uncertain regulation references are checked manually before use.
Native templates and current-source folders first; no model, autonomous public advice or hidden publication step.
Ordinary activity record saving stays retained without approval.
unknowns: Current presentation reuse and activity record requirements
research_questions: How much presentation writing is repeatable formatting versus audience-specific explanation?

already_counted.description: Capture the outreach activity and unresolved questions

incremental.description: Maintain current source folders and presentation templates

approvals.approved_version: Exact presentation, notes and handout for this audience, with current regulation references; altered claims require checking before delivery.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=92, gross=8, upkeep=1.5, central net=6.5 E1. Low: a new media issue requires bespoke wording and references, retaining 98.5 hours plus upkeep for zero net. High: a recurring community topic fits the existing template while audience-specific examples remain manual, retaining 94.5 hours plus upkeep for 4 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and document evidence-based recommendations for wildlife regulations or management programmes.

steps.what: Retrieve hunting, trapping, habitat and animal management evidence
Record evidence versions, species, locations, periods and limitations
Discuss wildlife balance, habitat concerns and practical management constraints with colleagues
Determine recommended revisions to regulations or animal management programmes
Write recommended revisions, supporting reasons, uncertainties and implementation considerations
Check and submit the final recommendation to the responsible management colleague

tasks.design: Configure evidence views in {DATA_PLATFORM} and a source-linked recommendation template in {DOCS}. Discussion and management judgement remain human; the separate proposal-writing step precedes a checked internal send through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence indexing and repetitive proposal structure add handling around wildlife judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and templates can reuse evidence identifiers and document structure.
tasks.still_hard: Ecological effects, competing interests and uncertain long-term consequences.
tasks.human_edge: A warden combines field experience with evidence and practical enforceability.
tasks.altitude: Make recommendations easier to trace without automating policy judgement.

reach.learn: State uncertainty and implementation constraints explicitly

evidence.claim: Native evidence worksheets and proposal templates can reduce repetitive preparation, with no measured warden policy-writing saving available.

assumptions: Counts the separate recommendation document and its internal submission; adoption or publication of a regulation is not this recommendation action.

Warden produces evidence source/version, species, location, period and limitation in s2, and proposed change and reasons in s4-s5; capture is counted. Incomparable monitoring periods require manual interpretation.
Native evidence views and templates first; no model decides policy or predicts offences.
Ordinary author saves remain retained without self-approval; the actual internal send checks its final version.
unknowns: Monitoring comparability and existing recommendation format
research_questions: Which source metadata and document sections can be reused across management proposals?

already_counted.description: Capture evidence and prepare recommendation wording

incremental.description: Maintain evidence views and proposal template

approvals.approved_version: Exact proposal, evidence references, qualifications and management recipient; any changed proposal requires another check before submission.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=89, gross=11, upkeep=2, central net=9 E1. Low: species-specific monitoring gaps and an unusual regulatory issue make the proposal bespoke, retaining 98 hours plus upkeep for zero net. High: consistent monitoring metadata permits evidence reuse while ecological reasoning remains manual, retaining 93 hours plus upkeep for 5 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Protect direct wildlife judgement and public engagement while reducing repeated record and material preparation.
reach: Coordinate custody records, training records and management evidence with adjacent specialists
role.ambitious_version: A warden with clearer records and more time for practical conservation, safe instruction and accountable public service.
